quests.instruction: Touch the body part that curves around and protects your brain, like a helmet. It is also the one found inside your head, just under your skin and hair!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: It is the hard bone inside your head!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Your skull protects your brain the same way a helmet protects your head!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that curves around your chest, like a protective cage. It is also the one that protects your heart and lungs, which sit safely inside it!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: They curve around your chest like a cage!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: Your ribs curve around your chest like a strong, protective cage!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that fills up with fresh air every time you take a big breath. It is also the one found inside your chest, on either side of your heart!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: They fill with air when you breathe in!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Your lungs breathe in and out over twenty thousand times a day!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you think, learn, and remember your favorite song. It is also the one found safely inside your head, protected by your skull!
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: It helps you think and remember!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: Your brain keeps working hard even while you are fast asleep!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that beats inside your chest and pushes blood all around your body. It is also the one you can feel go thump, thump, thump if you rest your hand on your chest!
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: You can feel it beating in your chest!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: Your heart beats about one hundred thousand times every single day!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that forms a long row of small bones down the middle of your back. It is also the one that lets you bend forward, backward, and side to side!
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: It runs down the middle of your back!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: Your backbone is made of many small bones stacked up like blocks!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that sits just below your mouth and touch it!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Think about this: You rest this on your hand when you think.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Some people have a small dimple right in the middle of it.

quests.instruction: Find the body part where you can feel your heart go thump, thump, thump and touch it!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Think about this: It is between your shoulders and your tummy.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: You can feel your chest rise and fall every time you breathe.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that is hard and strong, and holds your whole body up. It is also the one that a doctor can see clearly using a special X-ray picture!
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: They are hard and hold your whole body up!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: A grown-up has two hundred and six bones, but you have more right now!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that helps you jump up high off the ground -- it is also the one that forms the back of your leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.question: Calves
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the back of your lower legs!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Calves are the back of your lower leg, between your knee and your ankle!
quests.funFact: Your calves help push you up onto your tiptoes!

quests.instruction: Find the body part you nod up and down to say yes. It is also the one that holds your brain safe inside, like a helmet made of bone!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: It is the very top part of you!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Babies' heads grow very fast in the first year of life!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that helps you climb up the stairs. It is also the one you use to ride a bicycle around the block!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: You have two, and you use them to walk!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: The biggest muscle in your body is in the top of your leg.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that can be curly, straight, short, or long. It is also the one that keeps your head warm on a cold, snowy day!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: You comb or brush this part every day!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Hair helps keep your head warm in cold weather.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wiggles when you play the piano!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: You use these to point and count.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Your longest finger is usually the one right in the middle!

quests.instruction: Find the body part where you might wear a cozy scarf. It is also the one that lets your head nod, shake, and turn around!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: It is between your head and your shoulders!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck has bones stacked up like a tower of blocks.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you wash every morning to feel fresh!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You wash it every morning with water.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Every single face in the world is a little bit different.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to carry your favorite teddy bear!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Your hands are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Your two arms are almost always exactly the same length!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you lift up high when you play airplane!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: They are found where your arms begin.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Shoulders are some of the most flexible joints in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you puff up big when you blow out candles!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They turn rosy pink when you feel shy.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Cheeks turn pink or red when you blush.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you bend to lean on the table while you eat your dinner!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are between your shoulder and your wrist.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: You bend your elbows every time you eat with a spoon.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that never stops working, even while you are asleep!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Cover these and sounds become quiet.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: No two people's ears are shaped exactly the same, just like fingerprints!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you click together in a fun, silly dance -- it is also the one that forms the round back part of your foot!
quests.question: Heels
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the round back part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Heels are the round back part of your feet that touch the ground first!
quests.funFact: Your heel is actually the largest bone in your whole foot!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that moves around your mouth to help you speak clearly!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: It lives inside your mouth and moves when you talk.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue is covered in tiny bumps that help you taste your food.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that curves up into a big happy smile!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You press these together to blow a kiss.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: You use your lips to help make many different sounds when you talk.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that wraps around your entire body, like a big, snug coat -- it is also the one that covers your whole body, from head to toe!
quests.question: Skin
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It covers every single part of your body!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Skin covers your whole body and helps you feel hot, cold, soft, and rough!
quests.funFact: Your skin is the largest organ in your whole body!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we open flat to catch raindrops falling from the sky -- it is also the one that faces up when someone gives you a high five!
quests.question: Palms
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the flat, inside part of your hands!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Palms are the flat, soft inside part of your hands!
quests.funFact: Your palms have their own special lines and patterns, like your fingerprints!

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we wash with soap and water before we eat!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your arms.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Your hands can make thousands of different shapes and signs!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found inside your chest, on either side of your heart?
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: There are two, right beside your heart.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Your right lung is a little bigger than your left one.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found inside your head, just under your skin and hair?
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: It protects your brain, like a natural helmet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Babies' skulls have soft spots that harden as they grow.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that protects your heart and lungs, which sit safely inside it?
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: They protect your heart and lungs.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: You have twenty four ribs, twelve on each side.
